documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Appointment of Statutory Auditor/s
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited reported a 27.7% year-on-year increase in net sales for Q1FY27, reaching ₹2,107 crore. The company achieved an EBITDA of ₹407 crore, maintaining a 19% margin. Management highlighted successful debt reduction efforts, including a principal cash sweep of ₹160 crore during the quarter. The company continues to focus on operational integration, self-sufficiency in raw materials, and digital transformation initiatives. Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for FY26, marked by a 18.9% increase in net sales and a 40.8% rise in EBITDA.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 1 MnTPA for its integrated alloy steel plant.
orders_capacity.quote: JNIL is amongst the largest alloy steel (special steel) manufacturers in India with fully Integrated 1 Million Ton Per Annum (MnTPA) Alloy Steel Plant

orders_capacity.claim: The company's captive power plants have a combined capacity of 62 MW.
orders_capacity.quote: With a combined capacity of 62 MW, our captive power plants harness Waste Heat recovery, AFBC boilers and Blast Furnace as systems to deliver a reliable and energy-efficient power supply, ensuring uninterrupted steel production and enhanced operational efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The company reduced its secured debt by ₹160 crore during Q1FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has also done principal cash sweep of ₹160.00 Cr during Q1FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Secured debt outstanding as of June 30, 2026, was ₹1,884.04 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Secured Debt Outstanding as on 30 th June 2026 is ₹1,884.04 Cr, includes NCD holders’ Outstanding of ₹1,440.86 Cr and Working Capital Fund based Outstanding of ₹443.18 Cr.

capital_allocation.claim: Secured debt outstanding as of March 31, 2026, was ₹2,117.92 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Secured Debt Outstanding as on 31st March 2026 is ₹2,117.92 Cr, includes NCD holders’ Outstanding of ₹ 1638.64 Cr & Working Capital Fund based Outstanding of ₹ 479.28 Cr.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified various risks including fluctuations in earnings, intense competition, and potential time and cost overruns on contracts.
risks_headwinds.quote: The risk and uncertainties relating to these statements include, but are not limited to risks and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, our ability to manage growth, intense competition within Iron and Steel and castings industries including those factors which may affect our cost advantage, wage increases in India, our ability to attract and retain highly skilled professionals, time and cost overruns on fixed-price, fixed-time frame contracts

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces risks related to fluctuations in earnings and intense competition in the iron and steel industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: The risk and uncertainties relating to these statements include, but are not limited to risks and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, our ability to manage growth, intense competition within Iron and Steel and castings industries including those factors which may affect our cost advantage

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to maintain its future anchored in its core principles and remain open to change.
management_commitments.quote: I see the future of the Company to stay anchored in our principles, stay open to change and continue to build with humility, courage and conviction.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
